title: unified-rollouts-enhanced-quarantine-probing-metric-quorum-autorollback
author: Priya Nair
merge_outcome: Merged via squash merge. Squash commit created by author with short description 'enhance quarantine probing + metric quorum auto-rollback'.
description: Motivation: improve safety and detection for model rollouts by combining a probing/quarantine stage with a configurable metric-quorum autorollback engine. This PR implements a quarantine probing stage that routes a small percentage of traffic to the candidate model for extended probing, aggregates probe metrics into a quorum decision, and triggers automated rollback when quorum thresholds are exceeded. Design: 1) quarantine stage controller that supports manual and automatic promotion, with time-based and request-count-based gating; 2) probing harness that emits structured probe telemetry (latency/latency_p90/error_rate/semantic_regressions) to rollout metrics; 3) metric-quorum evaluator that computes weighted quorum across multiple metrics with configurable voting rules and grace windows; 4) safe-exit policies that escalate to canary rollback, shadow quarantine, or immediate full rollback depending on severity. Backwards compatibility: default policy preserves current canary/shadow flows; new behavior is opt-in per rollout via rollout.spec.quarantine.enabled. Implementation notes: added a lightweight in-memory quorum evaluator used by the rollout controller, extended rollout API schema to accept quorum rules, added e2e tests and unit coverage for quorum logic, added metrics and tracing spans for decision points. Testing & rollout plan: local unit tests + integration harness in perf-canary, staged rollout to internal staging with 1% probing for 24h, monitored via new dashboard panels. Checklist: [x] schema changes documented, [x] unit tests added, [x] e2e tests in perf-canary, [x] load-tested on dedicated infra, [x] updated rollout docs. Impact: improves early detection of regressions during staged rollouts and reduces noisy false positives by requiring a quorum across metrics before auto-rollback. See linked Linear tickets for follow-ups.

review_comments: Marco Alvarez: This looks solid. Please ensure quorum evaluator is deterministic across nodes; shared clocks could cause flakiness. Can we add a deterministic seed and a comment explaining assumptions?
Priya Nair (author): Added deterministic aggregation and a short note about clock skew assumptions in quorum.go. Also added tests that simulate skewed timestamps.
Sofia Chen: The telemetry payload size could increase; can we confirm batching and protobuf size limits? Also request adding a metric for quorum decision latency.
Priya Nair (author): Telemetry uses existing batching path in probes producer; added size check and a prometheus histogram 'rollouts_quorum_decision_latency_ms'.
Daniel Park: e2e flake observed once on perf-canary; failure was due to test timing assumption. Please make the test resilient to background retry jitter.
Priya Nair (author): Updated e2e to use eventual assertions with a 30s window; re-ran pipeline locally and in CI.
release_notes: Add opt-in 'quarantine' stage for rollouts with metric-quorum autorollback; new rollout.spec.quarantine and quorum rules; improved telemetry and dashboard panels for decision visibility.
notes_for_sre: When enabling in production, start with conservative quorum (e.g., require 2/3 metrics to exceed threshold, 5% probing for 24h). Monitor rollouts_quorum_decision_latency_ms and rollouts_quarantine_probe_error_rate. Migration adds DB columns; migrations run in a backward-compatible way.
